# Omni Calculator

> > Omni Calculator is a comprehensive online platform offering 1000+ specialized calculators across science, finance, health, construction, and everyday life applications.

Omni Calculator provides free, easy-to-use calculators for students, professionals, and everyday users. The platform covers core domains including mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, finance, health, construction, and conversions, with tools ranging from basic unit conversion to advanced statistical analysis and molecular biology calculations.

## Key Topics

- BMI Calculator
- DNA Analysis
- Genetics (Punnett Square, Hardy-Weinberg)
- Molecular Biology
- Physics & Kinematics
- Chemistry & Stoichiometry
- Statistics & Probability
- Financial Planning
- Health & Fitness
- Construction Materials
- Unit Conversion
- Educational Tools
- PCR & Laboratory Analysis
- Ecology & Carbon Footprint
- Sports Performance

## Core Calculator Collections

- [Math Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/math): Math calculators for algebra, trigonometry, and fractions
- [Physics Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/physics): Physics calculators for kinematics, dynamics, and thermodynamics
- [Chemistry Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/chemistry): Chemistry calculators for stoichiometry, molar mass, and reactions
- [Biology Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/biology): Biology calculators for genetics, DNA analysis, pet care, and gardening
- [Statistics Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/statistics): Statistics calculators for probability, odds, and analysis

## Health & Lifestyle Calculators

- [Health Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/health): Health calculators for BMI, body fat, and medical assessments
- [Food Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/food): Food calculators for recipes, cooking, and calorie counting
- [Sports Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/sports): Sports calculators for running pace, cycling, and performance
- [Everyday Life Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/everyday-life): Everyday calculators for fuel costs, commuting, and time planning

## Finance & Construction Tools

- [Finance Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/finance): Finance calculators for investments, retirement, ROI, and taxes
- [Construction Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/construction): Construction calculators for materials, roofing, and DIY projects
- [Conversion Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/conversion): Unit conversion tools for length, weight, temperature, and time

## Environmental & Educational Tools

- [Ecology Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/ecology): Ecology calculators for carbon footprint and environmental impact

## Advanced Reference Calculators

- [p-value Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/statistics/p-value): p-value calculator for hypothesis testing and statistical significance
- [Confidence Interval Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/statistics/confidence-interval): Confidence interval calculator for statistical inference and analysis
- [Log Calculator (Logarithm)](https://www.omnicalculator.com/math/log): Logarithm calculator with arbitrary base and natural logarithm
- [Test Grade Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/other/test-grade): Test grade calculator for percentage scores and letter grades
